hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the master function S(A,B,t) = A(t)*B(t)*A(t) by substituting the function names and variable from each instance map; this yields each target term exactly.
required_assumptions: A and B are unary functions over a common domain; multiplication denotes pointwise product.
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms share the sandwich/quadratic-form pattern f(x)*g(x)*f(x); they differ only by the outer function f, the inner function g, and the variable name.
